thread:
lily: Quick heads-up — we ran a dry-run of the new routing policy with quota enforcement on staging and saw ~12% extra token burn from fallback routes. numbers attached.
raj: link to the dashboard? :eyes:
lily: https://console.staging.redwood/dashboards/quota-burn?filter=policy:dryrun — check the fallback delta column
raj: hmm looks like shard-affinity isn't honored for some clients. which SDKs are still sending the old header shape?
sam: py and go are sending the expected array shape. TS shipped a change last week that sends a string when theres a single hint (routeHint -> route_hints).
emily: thats the culprit. TS returned a string not an array in the HTTP header, so router treats it as no hint -> fallback.
raj: Ugh. We can patch the router to accept both shapes, but prefer a client fix + a console tolerant flag for short term.
dante: Proposed plan: console accepts legacy shape for 48h (ff/quota-route-tolerant), TS patch immediately, then runtime shim in 72h if needed. Add migration logs in SDKs.
lily: timeline ok? want to re-run the dry-run tomorrow at 10:00 PST to verify impact.
sam: I can add tolerant parsing in runtime today as a defensive move, but we should still publish the SDK fix.
emily: TS PR ready in 5m, patch release approach: semver-patch with changelog.
raj: Also can we add a quick metric on the quota dashboard: "fallback token delta (dryrun)" so PMs can see rollback impact?
lily: yes please. low perf cost to compute, high value for rollback decisions.
console-bot: Created dashboard request ticket #ticket-5432 for "fallback token delta (dryrun)"
sam: Runtime PR: https://git.internal.redwood/repo/pull/999 — adds tolerant parse + INFO log when legacy shape detected (no behavior change).
emily: Published @redwood/ts-sdk v2.3.1 with fix. Release note: "fix(routeHints): accept single-string hint and convert to [hint]"
raj: Can we also add a tiny telemetry opt-in flag in SDKs to report header shape sent (legacy|v2) so we can quantify affected clients? opt-in default = false.
lily: Good call. make it opt-in, store as usage_flag in telemetry so we can query counts.
emily: Added opt-in flag in TS, will follow up with py/go PRs within the day.
sam: After TS publish, I'll flip the console tolerant ff on staging and re-run dry-run tomorrow.
raj: Heads-up for release notes / internal changelog: mention possible bump for TS and no-change for py/go.
dante: I'll draft a short note for release channel and customer-impact doc in case enterprise customers notice quota differences.
lily: Thanks everyone. Re-run tomorrow 10:00 PST.
deploy-bot: feature-flag ff/quota-route-tolerant queued for staging -> deploy at 10:05 UTC
notes: dry-run, routing policy, quota dashboard, sdk bump, telemetry opt-in
